standard_prerequisites.name: On the inverse image of an affine open of Y the f-ample invertible module behaves like an ample invertible module, so every finite type quasi-coherent module admits a jointly surjective finite family of maps from tensor powers of it
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the finite families of sections over each piece of the cover.

standard_prerequisites.name: Every section of a quasi-coherent module over a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme is contained in a finite type quasi-coherent submodule
standard_prerequisites.use: Trims the pushforward modules to finite type submodules so the resolution property of Y applies.

standard_prerequisites.name: The resolution property of Y produces surjections from finite locally free modules onto finite type quasi-coherent modules
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the maps E_{i,j} to H'_{j,i} whose pullback and twist give the jointly surjective family onto F.

core_obligations: Let F be a finite type quasi-coherent O_X-module and L an f-ample invertible module; choose an affine open covering Y = V_1 union ... union V_m and set U_j = f^{-1}(V_j); by Properties, Proposition characterize-ample, for each j there are finitely many maps s_{j,i} : L^{tensor n_{j,i}}|_{U_j} to F|_{U_j} jointly surjective (proof lines 9472-9483).

Form the quasi-coherent O_Y-modules H_n = f_*(F tensor L^{tensor n}) and view each s_{j,i} as a section over V_j of H_{-n_{j,i}}; argue that if finite locally free E_{i,j} with maps E_{i,j} to H_{-n_{j,i}} hitting s_{j,i} exist, then the corresponding maps f^*E_{i,j} tensor L^{tensor n_{i,j}} to F are jointly surjective and the lemma follows (proof lines 9484-9492).

Produce those maps: by Properties, Lemma quasi-coherent-colimit-finite-type, for each i, j choose a finite type quasi-coherent submodule H'_{i,j} of H_{-n_{j,i}} containing the section s_{i,j} over V_j; the resolution property of Y yields surjections E_{i,j} to H'_{j,i}, and composing with the inclusion completes the argument (proof lines 9492-9504).
proof_roadmap: Cover Y by affines and get finite jointly surjective families on each piece from f-ampleness (proof lines 9472-9483).
Set up the pushforward modules H_n and reduce to lifting the sections through finite locally free modules (proof lines 9484-9492).
Trim to finite type submodules and apply the resolution property of Y (proof lines 9492-9504).
difficulty_reason: 43 行、构造性论证：①仿射覆盖 + f-ample 在 U_j 上的振性（Properties proposition）给有限族 s_{j,i}；②造 H_n = f_*(F ⊗ L^{⊗n})，把 s_{j,i} 看作 V_j 上的截面，把命题归到「用有限局部自由模抬起这些截面」；③用 quasi-coherent-colimit-finite-type 取含截面的有限型子模，再用 Y 的 resolution property 给满射，拉回加 twist 得联合满射族。承重构造（截面搬运 + 抬升）都在 span 内；2 处跨章引用（Properties 两引）作导航桩。
